inputs.name: HostCommandService.constructor.sockets
inputs.description: The adapter the service uses to find a connection by its connectionId, read that connection's attachment, and send frames. A packet or device-drop frame only reaches a connection whose attachment has role 'device' and the deviceId the frame names, and otherwise the frame is ignored.

inputs.name: HostCommandService.constructor.link
inputs.description: The link service that ends a socket with a close code. It ends the frame's own socket with relayCloseCodes.protocol (4400) when the text is not a valid command, and it ends the target connection of a device-drop frame with that frame's code.

inputs.name: HostCommandService.constructor.offers
inputs.description: The pairing service that carries out the pairing-open, pairing-approve, pairing-deny and pairing-close commands. Its result, a RelayErrorCode or nothing, becomes the ack: a code gives ok: false with that error, and nothing gives ok: true.

inputs.name: HostCommandService.constructor.revocation
inputs.description: The service that revokes a device for a device-revoke command, called with that command's deviceId and for no other command. Its return value is not read, so the device-revoke ack is ok: true once revoke returns without throwing.

inputs.name: HostCommandService.handle.socket
inputs.description: The host's socket that the frame arrived on. It is ended with relayCloseCodes.protocol (4400) when the text is not a valid command, and it receives the 'ack' frame for each acknowledged command; packet and device-drop frames get no ack and only send to or end the connection they name.

inputs.name: HostCommandService.handle.text
inputs.description: The raw text of one host frame, parsed with JSON.parse and checked by HostCommandValidator.command; a frame that fails either step ends the socket with relayCloseCodes.protocol (4400). Parse and validation failures are caught inside the service and never escape as exceptions.

outputs.name: HostCommandService.handle
outputs.description: The promise resolves with no value once the frame has been processed, ended, or acknowledged, and it rejects only if a collaborator called while handling the frame throws or rejects, because handle has no throw of its own. A failed command is reported as an ack with ok: false, not as a rejection.

outputs.name: HostCommandService.constructor
outputs.description: The new HostCommandService instance. The constructor body is empty: it stores the four constructor parameters as readonly fields and creates a HostCommandValidator for command checks.
